repairs.original: 原题含四个子要求，逐项核对：(1) 用Nsight Compute分析：答案给出完整ncu采集命令（-o/--set full/--section/-k regex/-c/--list-sets/--query-metrics），与官方CLI文档WebFetch_4（'--set full | Collect the full set of sections'、'-k regex:foo'、'ncu --list-sets'）及Profiling Guide WebFetch_3（'--launch-count 1'、'--clock-control none'）逐项吻合；判读顺序（SpeedOfLight对比Compute/Memory throughput、MemoryWorkloadAnalysis看L1/L2命中与sectors/request、Occupancy对比Theoretical vs Achieved、WarpStateStats看stall）与WebFetch_3的section描述一致（'Memory can become a limiting factor...Mem Busy...Max Bandwidth...Mem Pipes Busy'；'Higher occupancy does not always result in higher performance, however, low occupancy always reduces the ability to hide latencies'）。(2) memory coalescing：'Ensure global memory accesses are coalesced whenever possible'、理想模式k线程访问k字、错位5段、stride=2致8段50%浪费、'Non-unit-stride global memory accesses should be avoided'、AoS→SoA与shared中转——与WebFetch_5官方Best Practices §10.2.1原文吻合。(3) shared memory/bank conflict：32 bank模型、broadcast例外、l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum指标、padding消除——bank模型与指标名在WebFetch_3（'Shared memory has 32 banks'、指标'l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu.sum'及'.pct_of_peak_sustained_active'子指标）与WebFetch_5（§10.2.3.1原文）均有支撑；padding示例答案自己标注'本轮未取得官方原文'，属诚实标注的常见做法而非错误。(4) occupancy calculator：ncu Occupancy section直接给出限制因素（WebFetch_3:'CTA occupancy is limited by threads, registers, shared memory, and hardware barriers. The CUDA Occupancy Calculator computes launch__occupancy_per_* metrics'）已覆盖；cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor/__launch_bounds__为答案明确标注的未核实先验知识，属部分次要内容无源，但主要流程（ncu Occupancy section+提升手段）有源。四子要求主体均有官方证据支撑，次要API无源已在答案中明示，整体判supported。
